summary: Cellectis S.A., a clinical-stage biotech, filed a Form 6-K on September 1, 2026, attaching a press release announcing participation in upcoming investor conferences (Wells Fargo, Baird, Barclays, Stifel, Jefferies). The release does not disclose any financial or strategic transaction, M&A activity, tender offer, restructuring, or other special situation. It is purely a routine corporate communication regarding management availability at conferences. There are no deal terms, board recommendations, advisors, or changes affecting shareholders. As such, the filing is a routine current report with no special-situations relevance.
